steps.name: Install dependencies and Chromium
steps.run:
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
# 2026-10-12: the apt mirror is occasionally ~100 kB/s (one shard in six took 3-4 min instead of ~25 s).
# Cap each attempt and retry on a fresh connection instead of waiting it out.
# A cache hit already holds the browser build; only the OS libraries (apt) are installed then, because
# the runner image does not persist them between jobs.
if [ "$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_CACHED" = "true" ]; then install_args="install-deps chromium"; else install_args="install --with-deps chromium"; fi
# v58.67 (CI 2026-10-23): a stalled mirror connection kept apt-get alive for 6+ minutes. apt now gives up a
# stalled connection after 20 s and retries it itself, so one slow shard costs seconds, not the attempt.
printf 'Acquire::Retries "3";\nAcquire::http::Timeout "20";\nAcquire::https::Timeout "20";\n' | sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99aio-network >/dev/null
# v58.68: apt reads and keeps its archives in the cached folder (the cache step above).
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/aio-apt-archives/partial"
printf 'Dir::Cache::Archives "%s/.cache/aio-apt-archives/";\nAPT::Keep-Downloaded-Packages "true";\nBinary::apt::APT::Keep-Downloaded-Packages "true";\n' "$HOME" | sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/98aio-archives >/dev/null
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if timeout 240 npx playwright $install_args; then break; fi
  [ "$attempt" = 3 ] && { echo "::error::playwright install failed 3 times"; exit 1; }
  echo "::warning::playwright install attempt $attempt timed out or failed; retrying"
  # v58.65/67: timeout stops npx, not the sudo apt-get it started, and that apt kept the dpkg lock — every
  # retry failed in two seconds (apt exit 100) and nothing deployed after 10/21 17:48. Stop the leftover apt,
  # wait for the lock, and let dpkg finish any half-configured package before retrying.
  sudo pkill -x apt-get || true
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend /var/lib/dpkg/lock >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 2; done
  sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
done
# apt wrote the archives as root; the cache step saves them as the runner user.
sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$HOME/.cache/aio-apt-archives" || true

steps.name: Reduced-scope release sits on a fully tested source commit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
source_sha="$(git log -1 --first-parent --format=%H "$EXPECTED_SHA" -- . ':(exclude)public-data' ':(exclude)architecture/asset-manifest.json' ':(exclude)architecture/release-manifest.json' ':(exclude)architecture/public-readiness.json' ':(exclude)public-config.json')"
if [ -z "$source_sha" ] || [ "$source_sha" = "$EXPECTED_SHA" ]; then
  echo "::error::reduced-scope CI cannot attest $EXPECTED_SHA: it changes files outside the refresh-generated paths"
  exit 1
fi
# P1952: every first-parent commit from source_sha up to (not including) this release holds the same
# non-generated tree, so a full push CI on any of them tests this code. A local commit merged with origin/main
# before the push leaves the merge commit (which push CI ran on) treesame to the code commit (which it did not),
# and data releases on top of it were refused (2026-10-21: v58.55 514c501 / merge a4b1b32).
tested=""
for candidate in $(git rev-list --first-parent "$EXPECTED_SHA" | sed "/^$source_sha\$/q" | grep -vx "$EXPECTED_SHA"); do
  full_runs="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=$candidate&event=push&status=success&per_page=1" --jq '.total_count')"
  if [ "${full_runs:-0}" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then tested="$candidate"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$tested" ]; then
  echo "::error::source commit $source_sha (and the first-parent commits above it) has no successful full push CI yet; this reduced-scope release is not attested"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Reduced-scope release $EXPECTED_SHA sits on fully tested source $source_sha (full push CI on $tested)"

steps.name: Open, update or close the expiry issue
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
title="[AIO] Manual reference values past their window"
body_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/manual-reference-expiry.md"
# P1736: list open issues directly (no search index: an unindexed HTML-comment marker would open a duplicate
# every run); match the body marker, then fall back to the exact title.
open_issues="$(gh issue list --state open --limit 200 --json number,title,body,createdAt)"
open_issue="$(jq -r '[.[] | select((.body // "") | contains("<!-- aio-manual-reference-expiry -->"))] | sort_by(.createdAt) | last | .number // empty' <<< "$open_issues")"
if [ -z "$open_issue" ]; then
  open_issue="$(jq -r --arg title "$title" '[.[] | select(.title == $title)] | sort_by(.createdAt) | last | .number // empty' <<< "$open_issues")"
fi
if [ "$EXPIRED" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -n "$open_issue" ]; then
    current_body="$(gh issue view "$open_issue" --json body --jq .body)"
    if printf '%s' "$current_body" | grep -qF "aio-manual-reference-expiry-digest:${DIGEST} "; then
      echo "Expiry issue #${open_issue} already lists ${DIGEST}"
    else
      gh issue edit "$open_issue" --title "$title" --body-file "$body_file"
      echo "Updated expiry issue #${open_issue}"
    fi
  else
    gh issue create --title "$title" --body-file "$body_file"
    echo "Created expiry issue"
  fi
elif [ -n "$open_issue" ]; then
  gh issue close "$open_issue" --comment "No manual reference value is past its window any more (watchdog run ${GITHUB_RUN_ID})."
  echo "Closed expiry issue #${open_issue}"
else
  echo "No expired manual reference."
fi

steps.name: Deploy canonical Worker
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
deploy_log="$(mktemp)"
if ! wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.proxy.deploy.toml --message "AIO AI proxy $SOURCE_SHA" 2>&1 | tee "$deploy_log"; then
  # 2026-10-14: a deploy token without the Workers AI permission refuses the [ai] binding. Deploy without it so
  # the release still lands; headline translation then stays on the shared OpenAI path (the route answers 503).
  # v57.61: only that permission failure may drop the binding; any other deploy error fails the job as-is.
  grep -q '^\[ai\]' worker/wrangler.proxy.deploy.toml || exit 1
  # v57.92 (audit W01): that pattern also matches a one-off authentication error, so the binding is dropped only
  # when the same deploy fails again — a missing permission repeats, a transient failure does not.
  sleep 15
  if wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.proxy.deploy.toml --message "AIO AI proxy $SOURCE_SHA (retry)" 2>&1 | tee "$deploy_log"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! grep -Eqi 'workers[ -]?ai|binding[^[:alnum:]]+ai([^[:alnum:]]|$)|ai[^[:alnum:]]+binding|authentication error|\[code: 10000\]|not authori[sz]ed|permission' "$deploy_log"; then
    echo "::error::Worker deploy failed for a reason other than the Workers AI permission; not retrying without the binding"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::warning::Worker deploy with the Workers AI binding failed; retrying without it"
  sed -i '/^\[ai\]$/,/^binding = "AI"$/d' worker/wrangler.proxy.deploy.toml
  wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.proxy.deploy.toml --message "AIO AI proxy $SOURCE_SHA (no Workers AI)"
fi

steps.name: Verify health, readiness, CORS, and fail-closed origin
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
ready="0"
consecutive=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 24); do
  status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-health.json" --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://ysnle.github.io' "$AI_PROXY_URL/health" || true)"
  if [ "$status" = '200' ] && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(h.schemaVersion!=='aio-worker-health.v1'||h.sourceSha!==process.env.EXPECTED_SHA||h.ai?.provider!=='openai'||h.ai?.model!=='gpt-6-luna'||h.ai?.automationConfigured!==true||h.ai?.configured!==true||h.ai?.quotaConfigured!==true||h.ai?.authorityReady!==true||h.ai?.authorityJurisdiction!=='us'||h.ai?.ready!==true||!Array.isArray(h.relay?.providers)||h.relay.providers.includes('fred')||h.relay?.quotaConfigured!==true)process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-health.json"; then
    consecutive=$((consecutive + 1))
    # P1433: three consecutive answers from the new revision before probing the gates.
    if [ "$consecutive" -ge 3 ]; then ready="1"; break; fi
  else
    consecutive=0
  fi
  sleep 5
done
if [ "$ready" != '1' ]; then cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-health.json" || true; echo "::error::ai_proxy_not_ready: HTTP $status"; exit 1; fi
cors_status="$(curl --silent --show-error --dump-header "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-cors.txt" --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: https://ysnle.github.io' "$AI_PROXY_URL/openai")"
if [ "$cors_status" != '204' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_cors_failed: HTTP $cors_status"; exit 1; fi
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').toLowerCase();if(!/^access-control-allow-origin:\\s*https:\\/\\/ysnle\\.github\\.io\\s*$/m.test(h))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-cors.txt"
for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do
  blocked="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://example.com' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","max_output_tokens":16,"input":[],"store":false}' "$AI_PROXY_URL/openai")"
  if [ "$blocked" != '405' ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
if [ "$blocked" != '403' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_origin_gate_failed: HTTP $blocked"; exit 1; fi
upstream_status="$(curl --silent --show-error --dump-header "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream-headers.txt" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream.json" --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://ysnle.github.io' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-AIO-Idempotency-Key: deploy-${EXPECTED_SHA}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" -d '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","max_output_tokens":32,"reasoning":{"effort":"none"},"input":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply exactly OK"}],"store":false}' "$AI_PROXY_URL/openai")"
# v57.92 (audit W02): a 429 carrying the Worker's own policy code (month budget, daily cap, rate limit) is the new
# code enforcing the shared ledger — the previous revision reads the same ledger, so rolling back fixes nothing.
# It is reported as operating-blocked; any other non-200 is still a code failure and rolls back.
policy_blocked=0
if [ "$upstream_status" = '429' ] && node -e "const r=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(!['monthly-budget','daily-cap','client-daily-cap','rate-limit'].includes(r?.error?.code))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream.json"; then
  policy_blocked=1
  echo "::warning::ai_proxy_operating_blocked: paid smoke answered 429 $(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).error.code)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream.json") — the deployed code enforced the budget; paid checks skipped, not rolled back"
elif [ "$upstream_status" != '200' ]; then cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream.json" || true; echo "::error::ai_proxy_upstream_failed: HTTP $upstream_status"; exit 1; fi
if [ "$policy_blocked" != '1' ]; then
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(r.status!=='completed'||!Array.isArray(r.output)||!r.output.some(x=>x?.type==='message'&&x.content?.some(p=>p?.type==='output_text'&&typeof p.text==='string')))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream.json"
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').toLowerCase();if(!/^x-aio-upstream-authority:\\s*durable-object-us\\s*$/m.test(h))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-upstream-headers.txt"
fi
automation_blocked="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","max_output_tokens":32,"input":"Reply exactly OK","store":false}' "$AI_PROXY_URL/openai")"
if [ "$automation_blocked" != '403' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_automation_gate_failed: HTTP $automation_blocked"; exit 1; fi
if [ "$policy_blocked" != '1' ]; then
automation_status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-automation.json" --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-AIO-Automation-Token: $AIO_AUTOMATION_TOKEN" -H "X-AIO-Idempotency-Key: deploy-automation-${EXPECTED_SHA}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" -d '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","max_output_tokens":32,"reasoning":{"effort":"none"},"input":"Reply exactly OK","store":false}' "$AI_PROXY_URL/openai")"
if [ "$automation_status" != '200' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_automation_upstream_failed: HTTP $automation_status"; exit 1; fi
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(r.status!=='completed'||!r.output?.some(x=>x?.type==='message'&&x.content?.some(p=>p?.type==='output_text'&&typeof p.text==='string')))process.exit(1)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aio-ai-automation.json"
fi
# v57.79: the personal-key FRED relay was retired; the Worker must answer it as an unknown provider.
relay_retired="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://ysnle.github.io' "$AI_PROXY_URL/relay?provider=fred&series_id=DGS10&limit=1")"
if [ "$relay_retired" != '400' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_retired_fred_relay_still_served: HTTP $relay_retired"; exit 1; fi
relay_blocked="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://example.com' "$AI_PROXY_URL/relay?provider=bok&statCode=722Y001&cycle=M&start=202601&end=202602")"
if [ "$relay_blocked" != '403' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_relay_origin_gate_failed: HTTP $relay_blocked"; exit 1; fi
relay_unknown="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://ysnle.github.io' "$AI_PROXY_URL/relay?provider=evil&series_id=DGS10")"
if [ "$relay_unknown" != '400' ]; then echo "::error::ai_proxy_relay_provider_gate_failed: HTTP $relay_unknown"; exit 1; fi

steps.name: Resolve attested release source
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = 'workflow_run' ]; then
  run_id="$WORKFLOW_RUN_ID"
  expected_sha="$WORKFLOW_SHA"
else
  run_id="$DISPATCH_RUN_ID"
  expected_sha="$DISPATCH_SHA"
fi
case "$run_id" in ''|null|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::deploy requires a numeric CI run id"; exit 1;; esac
case "$expected_sha" in *[!0-9a-f]*) echo "::error::expected sha must be lowercase hex: $expected_sha"; exit 1;; esac
[ "${#expected_sha}" -eq 40 ] || { echo "::error::expected sha must be 40 hex characters: $expected_sha"; exit 1; }

# A dispatched hand-over is re-checked against the same conditions the
# workflow_run path enforces, so the extra entry point cannot publish a
# revision that CI never validated.
gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$run_id" \
  --jq '[.name, .conclusion, (.head_branch // ""), (.head_sha // ""), (.head_repository.full_name // ""), (.event // "")] | @tsv' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.tsv"
IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r ci_name ci_conclusion ci_branch ci_sha ci_repo ci_event < "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-run.tsv"
[ "$ci_name" = 'CI' ] || { echo "::error::release requires the CI workflow"; exit 1; }
[ "$ci_repo" = "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" ] || { echo "::error::release CI must come from this repository"; exit 1; }
case "$ci_event" in push|workflow_dispatch) ;; *) echo "::error::release CI must be a main push or dispatch"; exit 1;; esac
[ "$ci_conclusion" = 'success' ] || { echo "::error::CI run $run_id concluded '$ci_conclusion', expected success"; exit 1; }
[ "$ci_branch" = 'main' ] || { echo "::error::CI run $run_id ran on '$ci_branch', expected main"; exit 1; }
[ "$ci_sha" = "$expected_sha" ] || { echo "::error::CI run $run_id tested '$ci_sha', expected $expected_sha"; exit 1; }

echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "expected_sha=$expected_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Resolved attested release: run=$run_id sha=$expected_sha branch=$ci_branch"

oversized=""
while IFS= read -r -d '' staged; do
  [ -f "$staged" ] || continue

if [ -n "$oversized" ]; then

collision_retry() {
  reason="$1"
  git rebase --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if [[ "${DISPATCH_RETRY:-}" == "collision" ]]; then
    echo "::error::${reason} again on the collision retry — main is changing the files this refresh produces; not retrying further."
    exit 1

  gh workflow run refresh-data.yml --ref main -f trigger=scheduler -f retry=collision

  git rebase origin/main || collision_retry "rebase conflict on $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | tr '\n' ' ')"
